content.thinking: The AP duplicate shows up under its own journal (2458), confirming it's in the ledger too. Next I'll verify the credit memo reconciles with the AP control account and check that invoice journals fall in the correct period.

input.sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_DT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_DT"/100 <> h."POST_DT"/100 limit 20

select h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT" from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_CD"='AP' and not exists (select 1 from "APINVH" i where i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") and h."SRC_REF" not like 'PAY-%' limit 20

select "PRD_ID", "STRT_DT", "END_DT", "CLOSE_DT", "STAT_CD" from "GLPERD" where "PRD_ID" in (select "PRD_ID" from "GLJRNH" where "POST_DT"/100 <> "PRD_ID"+202400) or "STAT_CD"='C' and "CLOSE_DT" is null
